
cdrom/cd-doom-load
Doom (USA)'s menu and E1M1 load, its CD commands at the game's spacing, 6 times. Needs Doom (USA) in the drive.
About two minutes; nothing prints until the end.

Per repeat, in the order written. P: a Pause's (or the SeekP's, marked S) write to its INT2. R lba xN: the ReadN's
write to its first INT1, then first INT1 to last. Cycles.
